shortDefinition: A self-hosted app catalog for Melusina built from a JSON manifest served as static files.

children.text: Static Store replaces third-party marketplaces with a simple JSON catalog plus a React SPA. Packages include checksums (and optional signatures) so you can verify integrity without relying on external hosts.
Deployable to any static hosting or inside Melusina.
No server-side code required; works offline/air-gapped.
Supports PGP signatures and SHA256 checksums.
